summary.text: Chris Richardson is a Republican member of the Colorado House of Representatives from District 56 who took office on January 8, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1989 to 2011.

paragraphs.text: Chris Richardson was born in Springfield, Massachusetts.

He earned a high school diploma from Classical High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Pennsylvania in 1988 and a military citation from the U.S. Army Command & General Staff College in 2001.
His career experience includes working as a military officer, professional logistician and resource manager, and as of 2024 he was affiliated with the American Legion and Veterans of Foreign Wars.
Richardson defeated Democrat Alessandra Navetta in the November 5, 2024 general election for House District 56, 75.7 percent to 24.3 percent.
He was unopposed in the June 30, 2026 Republican primary and faces Amy Lunde, the Libertarian candidate, in the general election.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the House Business Affairs and Labor Committee, the Transportation, Housing, and Local Government Committee and the Commission on Property Tax.
